input.quote: Contractor reserves the right to change rates with 30 days notice to Company.
input.rationale: There is no auto-renewal in this Agreement: § 2 (p0011) makes the term evergreen ("shall continue until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6"), and § 6(a) lets either party exit for convenience on fifteen (15) days' notice when no Statement of Work is outstanding. On the exit limb the deal is better than our preferred position (no renewal term, no notice window), so no renewal mechanics need to be added. The rule's second material limb — predictable renewal/roll-over pricing — fails, however: § 3(b) gives Contractor an uncapped unilateral right to change rates on 30 days' notice, with no annual frequency limit and no protection for work already under an outstanding Statement of Work (precisely the period when Company cannot use the § 6(a) convenience exit). We therefore cap increases at the lesser of CPI and 3% (preferred; 5% is our fallback), limit them to once per twelve months, and carve out outstanding Statements of Work.

ops.oldText: Contractor reserves the right to change rates with 30 days notice to Company.
ops.newText: Contractor may change rates no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, upon at least thirty (30) days prior written notice to Company, and any such increase shall not exceed the lesser of the increase in CPI over the preceding twelve (12) months and three percent (3%). No rate change shall apply to any Statement of Work then outstanding without Company's prior written consent.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement runs on an evergreen term with a 15-day exit, which works for us, but Contractor can currently raise rates at will on 30 days' notice, including mid-Statement of Work. We have limited rate changes to once a year, capped at the lesser of CPI and 3% (we can live with 5% as a fallback), and excluded work already under an outstanding Statement of Work.
proposal.summary: Cap Contractor rate increases at lesser of CPI and 3%, once per year, not applicable to outstanding SOWs.
